audit.whatIsWrong: Five strings say Null Sphere silences Mel: `early` ('respect is his Q silence — don't get tagged and locked out of Rebuttal'), `mid` context, `late` ('Q-silences my abilities so I can't W-wall or root him'), `spikes[3]`, `whys[5]` and `wants.foe[1]`.
audit.why: Null Sphere does not silence. Riot's text: 'fires an orb of void energy at a target, dealing damage and INTERRUPTING CHANNELS. The excess energy forms around himself, granting a temporary shield that absorbs magic damage.' Mel has no channel in her kit, so Null Sphere's utility effect does nothing to her at all. The current text builds an entire defensive plan around a lockout that cannot happen, and it costs the player real tempo — she will hold Rebuttal and Solar Snare waiting for a silence window that never arrives.
audit.corrected: Null Sphere interrupts channels and shields him. Mel has no channel, so it never locks her out — Rebuttal and Solar Snare are always available.

audit.whatIsWrong: `early`, `spikes[1]`, `whys[0]`, `whys[2]` and `wants.foe[1]` all attribute a magic shield to Kassadin's passive ('his passive magic shield', 'faster than his passive magic shield regenerates').
audit.why: The shield is on Null Sphere (Q), not the passive. Void Stone is flat magic damage reduction plus unit-collision immunity — it is always on and never 'regenerates' because it is not a resource. This matters more than a naming slip: Mel deals only magic damage, so she is facing permanent damage reduction PLUS a periodic magic-specific shield, which is two independent layers against her entire kit. Neither layer of the entry says this, and it is the reason her chip underperforms here.
audit.corrected: Void Stone is always-on magic damage reduction; the magic shield comes from Null Sphere. Both stack against Mel specifically, which is why magic penetration is a build requirement, not an option.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warns that Mel's own casting feeds Force Pulse.
audit.why: Force Pulse 'draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity'. Mel's pattern is constant casting — Radiant Volley every 10s down to 6s and Solar Snare every 11s down to 9s, both thrown at a target standing near him. She is therefore charging his E for him with the exact rotation the rest of the entry tells her to run. This is a genuinely obscure interaction and Mel is one of the champions most exposed to it.
audit.corrected: Casting near Kassadin charges Force Pulse. Expect the cone to be up sooner than his cooldown suggests, and do not treat a fresh Force Pulse as evidence he has been fighting.

audit.whatIsWrong: full `breakdown.cooldowns` calls Riftwalk 'his mobility spike' but never gives the number, and neither layer states it.
audit.why: Riftwalk is 5s at rank 1, 3.5s at rank 2, 2s at rank 3. That progression is the whole matchup clock — at 5s Mel still gets punish windows between blinks, at 2s there is effectively no gap left. Stating the three numbers converts 'win it early' from a slogan into a deadline.
audit.corrected: Riftwalk 5s / 3.5s / 2s — by rank 3 there is no window between blinks.

audit.why: Kassadin has a shield from the moment he puts a point in Null Sphere, and it absorbs magic damage specifically — i.e. exactly Mel's damage. 'Shieldless' is the opposite of true and it is the first line a player reads.
audit.corrected: He is a melee mage pre-6 but not a shieldless one; his Q shield is tuned against precisely what Mel deals.

audit.why: 50% over 8 games, carried consistently. The FAVOURED 4/10 grade in the full layer is defensible for a lane Mel is meant to win before level 6, and the content chart (Mel/Mel/Skill/Skill/Kassadin/Kassadin/Kassadin) tells the same scaling story. No elo-tier language present.

notes: IMPORTANT — champ-data/_kits/_missing-interactions.json contains a wrong entry for this matchup: "Kassadin's Null Sphere (Q) is a channel — your Solar Snare (E) cancels it outright." That is inverted. Null Sphere INTERRUPTS channels; it is not itself a channel and Solar Snare does not cancel it. The rule that generated it ('channel-interruptible') appears to have matched on the word 'channels' in Riot's description text. Anyone consuming that file for other Kassadin matchups will inherit the same error, so it is worth fixing at the generator rather than per-matchup. I did not write this claim into any proposed string.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are mine because Kassadin is a melee with no Riftwalk yet — he has to walk into my 550 range to last-hit, and that's where I punish him. At level 2 I pick up Solar Snare and Radiant Volley: root him on any greedy CS step, then rain Q on the snared field and feed empowered autos to start stacking Overwhelm. His passive magic shield will eat a little of my chip, but it can't regenerate as fast as I apply stacks if I keep the poke constant. The one thing to respect is his Q silence — don't get tagged and locked out of Rebuttal, and use my W wall to swallow that orb and fire it back at him.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are mine because Kassadin is a melee with no Riftwalk yet — he has to walk into my 550 range to last-hit, and that's where I punish him. At level 2 I pick up Solar Snare and Radiant Volley: root him on any greedy CS step, then rain Q on the snared field and feed empowered autos to stack Overwhelm. Two things blunt that chip, and neither is his passive shield, because he hasn't got one: Void Stone is flat magic damage reduction that is always on, and Null Sphere grants a shield that absorbs magic specifically. His Q does not silence — it interrupts channels, and I have none — so Rebuttal is never locked out of my hands.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 I keep ranking Q and stacking Overwhelm, but this is where it levels out — he's farming for 6 and I can't quite kill him through his shield without a root landing first. The real shift is level 6: Riftwalk comes online and his blink lets him sidestep my Solar Snare, the single tool my whole zone depends on. Once he has R, my poke war turns into hide-and-seek — he flickers around my snare and inches the gap closed. Hold Solar Snare for when he commits rather than throwing it on cooldown, because a whiffed root against a blinking Kassadin just hands him a free window to walk up.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 I keep ranking Q and stacking Overwhelm, but this is where it levels out — he's farming for 6 and I can't kill through Void Stone and a Null Sphere shield without a root landing first. Watch what I am feeding him: Force Pulse charges off spells cast in his vicinity, so my own Q and E casts load the cone he slows me with. The real shift is level 6: Riftwalk is 5s at rank 1 and falls to 2s by rank 3, so his blink sidesteps the single tool my whole zone depends on. Hold Solar Snare for when he commits rather than throwing it on cooldown, because a whiffed root against a blinking Kassadin just hands him a free window to walk up.

edits.before: This is Kassadin's game, full stop — he's a hard scaler and I'm a fragile artillery mage with no dash and one CC. At 2+ items his stacked Riftwalks let him blink straight onto me, Q-silences my abilities so I can't W-wall or root him, and his AP burst deletes my squishy frame before Golden Eclipse can detonate the Overwhelm I built. I don't try to solo-duel a fed Kassadin late; I use my early lead to take plates and pressure the map so his scaling never matters, and in fights I detonate R from max range before he closes, then peel with Solar Snare the instant he Riftwalks in. Win it early or it slips away.
edits.after: This is Kassadin's game, full stop — he's a hard scaler and I'm a fragile artillery mage with no dash and one CC. At 2+ items his stacked Riftwalks let him blink straight onto me, and every point of damage I own is magic, which is exactly what Void Stone reduces and what his Null Sphere shield absorbs — magic penetration is not a luxury item here, it is the build. He never silences me, so Rebuttal and Solar Snare are always in hand; the problem is landing them on a 2s blink. I don't solo-duel a fed Kassadin. I take plates with my early lead, pressure the map so his scaling never matters, and detonate R from max range before he closes.
